# 4-Week Intensive Course Schedule (Summer 2026)

**Course Format:** 20 business days (Mon-Fri), May 18 - June 12, 2026
**Daily Engagement:** 112.5 minutes (videos + Colab notebooks + exercises + quizzes + project work)
**Instruction Style:** Micro-videos + Google Colab notebooks with Gemini AI assistance
**Fridays (Days 5, 10, 15, 20):** Synchronous lecture, 10:30 am – 12:00 pm EST (recorded) — covers weekly topics, project milestones, Kaggle competition, and Q&A. Pre-recorded micro-videos remain available for review.

## Project Milestones (groups of four randomly assigned members)

The single source of truth — including the assessment structure (40% milestones / 20% peer evaluation / 40% poster), the per-milestone rubrics, and the optional Fall 2026 conference presentation — is [`_final_project/2026Summer/final_project_milestone_reference.md`](https://github.com/davi-moreira/2026Summer_predictive_analytics_purdue_MGMT474/blob/main/_final_project/2026Summer/final_project_milestone_reference.md){target="_blank"}.

- **Week 1 (Day 5, Fri May 22) — Initial Project Proposal:** prediction goal + motivation + data overview + preliminary methods + expected contributions (1–2 pages). Detail: [`milestone_01_proposal.md`](https://github.com/davi-moreira/2026Summer_predictive_analytics_purdue_MGMT474/blob/main/_final_project/2026Summer/milestone_01_proposal.md){target="_blank"}.
- **Week 2 (Day 10, Fri May 29) — Simple Model + Performance Evaluation:** dataset exploration + feature engineering + missing-value handling + baseline model with k-fold CV. Detail: [`milestone_02_baseline_model.md`](https://github.com/davi-moreira/2026Summer_predictive_analytics_purdue_MGMT474/blob/main/_final_project/2026Summer/milestone_02_baseline_model.md){target="_blank"}.
- **Week 3 (Day 15, Fri Jun 5) — More Complex Model + Tuning + Draft Abstract:** complex-model implementation, hyperparameter tuning, draft abstract (~250 words). Detail: [`milestone_03_complex_model_and_abstract.md`](https://github.com/davi-moreira/2026Summer_predictive_analytics_purdue_MGMT474/blob/main/_final_project/2026Summer/milestone_03_complex_model_and_abstract.md){target="_blank"}.
- **Week 4 (Day 20, Fri Jun 12) — Final Research Poster + Peer Evaluation:** single PDF named `<group-number>.pdf` plus each member's individual peer-evaluation form. Detail: [`milestone_04_final_poster.md`](https://github.com/davi-moreira/2026Summer_predictive_analytics_purdue_MGMT474/blob/main/_final_project/2026Summer/milestone_04_final_poster.md){target="_blank"}. Optional Fall 2026 conference presentation: <https://www.purdue.edu/undergrad-research/conferences/index.php>{target="_blank"}.

## Kaggle Case Competition (individual or pairs)

- **Competition:** Summer 2026 MGMT47400 Case Competition: Bank Churn (predict customer churn probability, AUC-ROC)
- **Deadline:** Fri June 12, 2026 at 11:59 PM (Kaggle + Brightspace code submission)
- **Grading:** At least one submission (30% of competition grade) + leaderboard ranking (70% of competition grade)

## Core Course References

- **James, Witten, Hastie, Tibshirani.** *An Introduction to Statistical Learning* (ISLP) + Python labs. Download: [https://www.statlearning.com/](https://www.statlearning.com/){target="_blank"}
- **Hastie, Tibshirani, Friedman.** *The Elements of Statistical Learning* (ESL).
- **Provost, Fawcett.** *Data Science for Business*.
- **Pedregosa et al.** "Scikit-learn: Machine Learning in Python." *JMLR*.
- **scikit-learn User Guide** (pipelines, preprocessing, model selection, metrics, inspection).
- **Chip Huyen.** *Designing Machine Learning Systems* (deployment thinking, monitoring).

:::
